basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.summary: First-year PhD candidate at HKUST NLP Group, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology. Research interests include LLM Reasoning and Reinforcement Learning, Hallucination in Vision-Language Models, and LLM Truthfulness and Interpretability.
